question: If the radius of the right circular cone is increased by 20% and its height is decreased by 25%, then the volume of the right circular cone will be increased by:
solution:
**Given:**

Original radius (r) of the right circular cone

Original height (h) of the right circular cone

Radius increased by 20% ⇒ New radius = 1.2r

Height decreased by 25% ⇒ New height = 0.75h

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a right circular cone = (1)/(3) pi r² h

**Calculation:**

Original Volume (V₁) = (1)/(3) pi r² h

New Volume (V₂) = (1)/(3) pi (1.2r)² (0.75h)
